summary: Delta spec: when canShare(files) is true, skip automatic download and prefer immediate navigator.share; keep Share button as gesture retry. AC-SI-1…5 in loop/spec-share-immediate.md.
goal: Simplify export delivery to native share immediately instead of download-then-share

learnings.insight: Immediate share after async MediaRecorder.onstop usually lacks user activation (NotAllowedError). Product still wants share-first: skip download when canShare, attempt share once, keep Share button for the real gesture.
learnings.action: Gate downloadBlob behind !canShareVideoFile(file); always attempt shareVideoFile on share-capable success; UI copy Ready to share not Downloaded.
